_comment: "עיצוב בון" — the kitchen ticket designs and the ticketStyle contract (P:/specs/kitchen-ticket-designs.md §1, §6–§10). Shared byte-for-byte by pos-server tests/fixtures (app/services/kitchen_ticket_style.py, client/src/lib/kitchenTicketStyle.ts — the dashboard preview) and pos-android app/src/test/resources (hardware/kitchen/KitchenTicketRenderer). `samples`: tickets in the till's KitchenTicketDto shape (+ `openedAt`, the table's opening, optional); each must show every string of `mustAppear.all` and `mustAppear.byTemplate[template]` when drawn with `styles[template]` at 58 and 80 mm — the drawn texts in order, joined by one space, bidi marks (U+200E, U+200F, U+2066–U+2069) removed, times in `timeZone`. `looks`: each template before the ink saver (no solid black but classic_legacy's: `blackParts`); `styles`: as the cloud sends it with nothing set (kitchenTicketInkSaver on); `metrics` + `textRules`: sizes per paper width and the one-line fitting; `resolveCases`: resolve_with_params(input) == expect. Items marked "ללא בון" never reach the ticket (the till's routing drops them).

textRules.table: a table name of digits only is written "שולחן 12"; any other name as it is
textRules.headline: customer (when listed and set) › table › sale › "הזמנה"; the zone follows the table
textRules.items: totals count each line's quantity when whole, else 1; courses count distinct non-empty course names
textRules.elapsed: whole minutes from openedAt to createdAt; no openedAt — no elapsed
textRules.mods: plusminus / words / bullets: a mod's leading "+ " and a removal's leading "בלי " are taken off first
textRules.fit: fit: an item line (quantity + name) at itemSize[paper][maxSize] × fontScale; while it does not fit one line, one fitStep smaller, down to itemSize[paper][minSize]; still too long — it wraps there, continuations under the name (hangingIndent). wrap: at maxSize, wrapping.
textRules.inlineMods: mods.layout inline: choices, removals and a short note (no important note, never allergies) join the item line after " · " when the whole line fits at the size the name took; else each on its own indented line at detailRatio × that size
textRules.header: header.layout inline: the headline at headerRatio[header.size] × itemSize[paper][maxSize], then the other fields after " · " on the same line as far as they fit; the rest on the next line
textRules.order: order.by added: as added, a group runs while the course stays the same; course: by the courses' sortOrder (a course not among them after them, as first added), no course first / last by order.noCourse; category: by the catalog tree, depth first, siblings by (sortOrder, name); custom: by the first order.list entry the line matches (its course by id or name, or its category or an ancestor), the rest at the end. Within a group as added; grouping seat: by seat ("מ2" before "מ10"), no seat last. order.groupHeaders: a heading per group in bands.course; without one a line's course prints beside its seat
textRules.blackArea: solid black = fills only (bands / header / qty box / allergy / important note set to fill); text and lines are not counted
